placement_rationale.L5: Use the vacated U4/L2 region, F.Cu at (119.8,78.8), 0 degrees. Pad 1 faces the VPROT input bank C82/C83 to the left, with C84 near the boost controller; pad 2 faces new U14 SW pins and D29 to the right. D29 is rotated -90 so its SW anode faces the U14 top SW pins and its cathode faces C77/C78. Keep the compact switching triangle north/west of U14; its FB/COMP/FREQ components are south/east, outside the inductor courtyard. L5 has an approved 12.5x10.7 courtyard and a documented 4.0 mm max body, leaving 1.1 mm body-only margin to the 5.1 mm envelope. Keep the engineered land unchanged; no solder/bench/height qualification is claimed.
placement_rationale.positive_control: R86/R87 are a parallel vertical divider east of U14; COMP/SS/FREQ components are south/east of U14, not between its SW pins and the inductor/rectifier. Intended Kelvin feedback comes from the quiet output bank, not the diode switching current path. U14 EP/PGND require deliberate local return copper and multiple ordinary 0.3 mm through-vias in the routing phase.
placement_rationale.negative_additions: Initial non-overlapping locations preserve all retained transforms as required. C73/C74 extend the quiet negative LDO output/input banks. Negative IBB additions C75/C76/C89-C92/D30 and EN parts are PROVISIONAL: the much larger L1 and SR2 VIN-to-NRAW bypass topology require a subsequent reviewed common-tool placement batch to move affected old parts and consolidate these additions around U3. These initial separated positions are NOT an accepted power-stage layout and must not be routed as a finished design.
placement_rationale.retained_replacements: L1/L4 receive the exact approved local land at their original origin/rotation/side. Their larger courtyard collisions, if any, are recorded for subsequent common-tool moves, not repaired secretly during sync.
placement_rationale.new_field_presentation: New small R/C reference labels are hidden, like the existing dense passive banks; new U14/L5/D29/D30 references use mirrored B.Silkscreen at the footprint origin. Values and sourcing fields are hidden. Existing fields on retained/replaced footprints are preserved byte-for-byte.

supersession.reason: Protect original pre-metadata net membership too; a surviving ref whose pad net was renamed still owns its old copper. Corrected candidate rebuilt from immutable UUID-repaired source; all 38 withdrawn deletions are restored verbatim.
